subject: Municipal Finance Update
overview: The Committee of the Whole met with Finance Director Bob Dickinson for an update on city finances, software limitations, and FY2024 budget planning. The Council approved motions requesting regular year-to-date financial reporting and detailed records of city legal expenses.

items.title: Paper 22-604 Finance Department Update
items.summary: Finance Director Bob Dickinson presented a municipal financial update covering audit progress, software system limitations, Proposition 2 1/2 levy calculations, special revenue fund deficits, and preliminary FY2024 budget preparation.

items.title: Motion on Year-to-Date Budget and Grant Reporting
items.summary: The Council approved a motion requesting that the administration publish monthly year-to-date budget reports on the city website and explore including grant and special revenue account details in future budget books.

items.title: Motion on Warrants and Legal Expenditures
items.summary: The Council approved a motion requesting FY2022 warrants and a detailed accounting of city legal expenses, specifically regarding payments to KP Law.
